chunks.title: Generate canonical PGN
acceptance_criteria: PGN generation consumes canonical game and ordered move records rather than browser text
Event, Site, Date, Round, White, Black, Result, and TimeControl headers are valid and populated when known
Movetext uses canonical SAN for captures, checks, mates, castling, and promotion with the correct final result token
Focused tests cover untimed/timed, incomplete/completed, special-move, and escaped-header cases

chunks.title: Verify PGN reproduces canonical games
acceptance_criteria: Repository-owned verification replays exported moves through the authoritative coordinate move path
Representative exports reproduce the saved final FEN, result, and move count
Corrupt or inconsistent canonical records fail export verification with actionable errors
Tests cover ordinary games, castling, en passant, promotion, checkmate, and drawn results

chunks.title: Expose authorized PGN downloads
acceptance_criteria: Completed or saved games download as valid .pgn responses with safe deterministic filenames
Owned games require the active owner and cannot be exported by another local user
Guest game export uses only the active guest session and leaks no durable records
The browser exposes a clear download action and endpoint tests cover headers, content, ownership, and missing games

chunks.title: Define and prove the future-engine adapter seam
acceptance_criteria: An engine request contains canonical FEN plus stable game context and returns a stable coordinate move proposal
A deterministic fake adapter can propose a move without importing HTTP, persistence, or UI concerns
Human and fake-engine proposals pass through the identical authoritative legal-move application path
Illegal adapter proposals are rejected without mutation and participant type can identify future engine seats

chunks.title: Document and integrate export and engine boundaries
acceptance_criteria: Generated API documentation includes the PGN download contract and content type
Architecture documentation identifies PGN and engine adapters as canonical-state consumers
Integration tests complete and export representative saved games without final-position divergence
No engine binary, model, analysis process, difficulty system, or runtime dependency is added
